A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 4.0 - 6.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability is not present in the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ismn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Music Number (ISMN)](https://ismn-international.org/ismn/the-ismn/) is a unique numeric identifier for printed music (notated music) standardized by [ISO 10957](https://www.iso.org/standard/83122.html). It consists of either 10 characters (starting with the letter "M" for assignments prior to January 1, 2008) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISMN is composed of four parts: the GS1 prefix `979-0`, a registrant element, an item element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9790006538424`).
Specifies whether the License is listed as free by the Free Software Foundation (FSF).
QUDT unit is used for measurement criteria based on product type, region and use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).
Describes the type of annotation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: demonstration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Demonstrating and monitoring or recording that the item under verification to confirm that a requirement is met by the item under verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patchedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a patch for the `from` Element (`from` patchedBy `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tls
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Transport Layer Security, or TLS, is a widely adopted security protocol designed to facilitate privacy and data security for communications over the Internet.
Version string for an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: log
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Time-stamped records capturing system or operational data recorded as usually as a response to specific triggers in a specified environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when someone reviews the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.
Provides an ExternalMap of Element identifiers.
Timestamp of impact statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: framework
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software framework.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport

The location for picking up a package or item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: coordinatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability is coordinatedBy the `to` Agent(s) (vendor, researcher, or consumer agent).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isrc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Recording Code (ISRC)](https://isrc.ifpi.org/isrc-standard) is a unique 12-character alphanumeric identifier for sound recordings and music video recordings standardized by [ISO 3901](https://www.iso.org/standard/64817.html). While the "ISRC" label and grouping hyphens used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `USCA28900153`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasExample
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an example for the `from` Element (`from` hasExample `to`).
The location for dropping off or delivering a package or item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the release notes for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's build phase, during development.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pass
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a successful evaluation where the requirement or condition is clearly met.
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/intendedUse](../../Core/Properties/intendedUse.md) instead.
The intended use of a given dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.
Conveys information about how VEX status was determined.
Specifies the CVSS vector string for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
Defines the level of automation a system possesses.
Identifier for product production batch.

Class that describes an InstantiateVirtualHardwareProcess that is used to define VirtualHardware and its source.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
Specifies the licenseId that is preferred to be used in place of a deprecated License or LicenseAddition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element contains each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).
A license or addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
Evaluation is an outcome considering results of a verification.
An actual change to a product.
Domain in which the AI package can be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding

RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to package such as OpenSSF scorecards.
Identifies the text of one or more copyright notices for a software Package, File or Snippet, if any.
Specifies the level of support associated with an artifact.
Provides a NamespaceMap of prefixes and associated namespace partial URIs applicable to an SpdxDocument and independent of any specific serialization format or instance.
The planned location that a good, product or material is stored.
Categories of presence or absence.
evidenceCategory refers to a category of documented or observable proof.
It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.
Product Part Number as defined by OEM.
A code that identifies a county.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset can be shared within a community of peers and partners.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe22
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.
Identifies the full text of a License or Addition.

An Organization representing the SPDX Project.
Identifies all the text and metadata associated with a license in the license XML format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 1422](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1422/). The media type shall be one of application/x-x509-ca-cert or application/x-x509-user-cert.
The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.
Specifies the type of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: symlink

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).
Specifies a country code of the location.
Specifies the value of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).

A transport route refers to the planned path or network used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.
Provides information about the primary purpose of the software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli

It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).
